review_notes: Independently read the complete current proposal.json, functionality.md, both disposition ledgers, coverage.json, and unresolved.json. The reviewed proposal contains six supported writes, all to owned subjects, and no new links, entities, merges, or follow-ups.

Read both owned files completely in canonical and rendered form and enumerated all six subjects, 29 baseline facts, and four outgoing links. Rendered aliases were not used as independent semantic evidence.

The four reset/TU corrections are supported by comparing the complete reset implementation with plActionStats: x5B8[4] is declared but not assigned. The proposed text correctly avoids promises about padding, unused bitfield storage, or complete record zeroing.

The allocator game-mapping correction accurately distinguishes conditional identity allocation from universal repeated-frame counting prevention. The inferred-name correction preserves a supported hypothesis while removing unsupported compiled instruction-identity language.

Foreign evidence independently verifies the accessor's embedded mutable destination and slot predicate, player-system initialization, reset caller, fighter and item allocation predicates, separate plStale storage, attack-count consumer, and conditional hit consumer.

Sequence boundaries are correct: initialization stores 1; allocation returns the pre-state; pre-state 65535 leaves 1, and pre-state zero returns zero and leaves 1. References to reset reusing identifiers are understood as sequence reinitialization by plAttack_80037590, not the per-player statistics reset.

The functionality document appropriately separates source-level behavior from unproved compiled layout, historical names, numerical gameplay mappings, records/UI formulas, and end-to-end collision provenance. Local integer-only behavior and absence of callbacks or ownership transfer are supported.
